interpretation: Engineering sensitivity, not calibrated hardware distribution or success rate
nominal_gate: All original trial NPZ arrays and comparison model hash exact; stop before mutations on any mismatch
mass: Scale football body mass and principal inertia together using explicit original inertial frame before compilation. Geometry and density distribution shape fixed.
friction: Scale all five explicit ball-Aero hand/mount pair friction coefficients only. No geom/floor/body friction edits.
native_force: Scale exactly 14 native actuator forcerange endpoints by .75, never increase caps.
metrics: first 20ms summed contact force and impulse
